cond_0001.intro:
[Company name masked] is a financial and economic consulting firm that exists to restore integrity to the financial system through forensic data analytics. We work with government agencies and law firms in their efforts to combat a wide array of financial fraud, in areas ranging from securities to healthcare to crypto assets.
We are looking for strong candidates with quantitative and/or finance backgrounds and a natural curiosity to learn to join our team and help tackle complex projects by efficiently analyzing data.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Plan, develop, and take ownership in data-intensive investigations of financial fraud
Conduct background research to develop hypotheses of where fraud occurs
Write scripts to retrieve and organize data; parse free-form text fields, images, and spreadsheets to derive insights
Construct and analyze large datasets to find fraudulent patterns; develop quantitative and empirical methods to detect where fraud occurs
Summarize and present findings to technical and non-technical audiences
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Completion of bachelor's degree in statistics, mathematics, engineering, computer science, data science, economics, or other quantitative field
Demonstrated experience with R, Python, and/or SQL
Attention to detail
Highest ethical standards
Strong teamwork abilities
Preferred Requirements
Excellent skills in R, Python, and/or SQL
Knowledge of crypto, decentralized finance, or smart contracts
Intellectual curiosity and interest in fraud analysis
Demonstrated aptitude for research

We work with government agencies and law firms in their efforts to combat a wide array of financial fraud, in areas ranging from securities to healthcare to crypto assets.
We are looking for strong candidates with quantitative and/or finance backgrounds and a natural curiosity to learn to join our team and help tackle complex projects by efficiently analyzing data. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with forensic data analysis and financial investigations.
cond_0356.responsibilities:
Plan, develop, and take ownership in data-intensive investigations of financial fraud
Conduct background research to develop hypotheses of where fraud occurs
Write scripts to retrieve and organize data; parse free-form text fields, images, and spreadsheets to derive insights
Construct and analyze large datasets to find fraudulent patterns; develop quantitative and empirical methods to detect where fraud occurs
Summarize and present findings to technical and non-technical audiences
cond_0356.requirements:
Completion of bachelor's degree in statistics, mathematics, engineering, computer science, data science, economics, or other quantitative field
Demonstrated experience with R, Python, and/or SQL
Attention to detail
Intellectual curiosity and interest in fraud analysis
Highest ethical standards
Strong teamwork abilities
Excellent skills in R, Python, and/or SQL
Knowledge of crypto, decentralized finance, or smart contracts
Demonstrated aptitude for research

cond_0605.intro:
[Company name masked] is a financial and economic consulting firm that exists to restore integrity to the financial system through forensic data analytics. Demonstrated expertise in R, Python, and/or SQL, with strong command of these tools in applied data work
Exceptional attention to detail
Proven intellectual curiosity and deep interest in fraud analysis
Highest ethical standards
Strong teamwork abilities with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams
Advanced knowledge of R, Python, and/or SQL
Solid understanding of crypto, decentralized finance, or smart contracts
Demonstrated track record of research aptitude and independent analytical thinking
